```{r news, echo=FALSE}
# Builds the category buttons and one card per item from the `news` list above.
library(htmltools)

news <- rmarkdown::metadata$news

filter_button <- function(label, pressed = "false") {
  tags$button(type = "button", class = "news-filter", `data-category` = label,
              `aria-pressed` = pressed, label)
}

# one image at a time, with buttons to move between them if there are several
photo_gallery <- function(photos) {
  div(class = "news-figure news-photos",
      Map(function(p, i) {
        a(href = p$src, target = "_blank", hidden = if (i > 1) NA,
          img(src = p$src, alt = p$alt, loading = "lazy"))
      }, photos, seq_along(photos)),
      if (length(photos) > 1)
        div(class = "news-photo-nav",
            tags$button(type = "button", class = "news-prev", `aria-label` = "Previous image",
                        tags$i(class = "bi bi-chevron-left", `aria-hidden` = "true")),
            span(class = "news-count", `aria-live` = "polite", paste0("1 / ", length(photos))),
            tags$button(type = "button", class = "news-next", `aria-label` = "Next image",
                        tags$i(class = "bi bi-chevron-right", `aria-hidden` = "true"))))
}

card <- function(n) {
  tags$article(
    class = "news-card", `data-category` = n$category,
    photo_gallery(n$photos),
    div(class = "news-body",
        if (!is.null(n$credit)) div(class = "news-credit", n$credit),
        div(class = "news-meta", paste(n$category, "&middot;", n$date) |> HTML()),
        h2(class = "news-title", n$title),
        tags$p(class = "news-text", n$text),
        if (!is.null(n$link))
          a(class = "news-link", href = n$link, target = "_blank", n$link_text)))
}

tagList(
  div(class = "news-filters", role = "group", `aria-label` = "Filter news by category",
      filter_button("All", "true"),
      lapply(rmarkdown::metadata$categories_list, filter_button)),
  div(class = "news-grid", lapply(news, card))
)
```

```{=html}
<div class="news-more">
  <a class="btn btn-primary" href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/demon-lab/posts/" target="_blank"><i class="bi bi-linkedin"></i> Follow us on LinkedIn</a>
</div>

<script>
// Category buttons: show only the cards of the chosen category.
(function () {
  var buttons = document.querySelectorAll(".news-filter");
  buttons.forEach(function (button) {
    button.addEventListener("click", function () {
      var chosen = button.dataset.category;
      buttons.forEach(function (b) { b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", b === button); });
      document.querySelectorAll(".news-card").forEach(function (card) {
        card.hidden = chosen !== "All" && card.dataset.category !== chosen;
      });
    });
  });

  // Image buttons: move through a card's images, starting again after the last.
  document.querySelectorAll(".news-photos").forEach(function (box) {
    var photos = box.querySelectorAll("a");
    var count = box.querySelector(".news-count");
    var current = 0;
    function move(step) {
      current = (current + step + photos.length) % photos.length;
      photos.forEach(function (p, k) { p.hidden = k !== current; });
      count.textContent = (current + 1) + " / " + photos.length;
    }
    if (!count) return;
    box.querySelector(".news-prev").addEventListener("click", function () { move(-1); });
    box.querySelector(".news-next").addEventListener("click", function () { move(1); });
  });
})();
</script>
```
